title: During the post-Aldous conversation with Tamsin, choosing 'back her — a door that holds' read as generic emotional support, not as a binding decision about whether the Hundred Gallery mine stays sealed — yet it swung Brother Osk's regard by -2 on the spot and the ending epilogue treats it as a permanent, recorded outcome.
